settings.title: Settings
settings.closeToTrayHint: When enabled, clicking ✕ hides the window instead of quitting. Use the system tray to quit. Requires restart.
settings.scheduleHint: Set a time for downloads to start. Leave empty to start immediately.
settings.postActionHint: Choose an action to run when all downloads finish.
settings.proxyHint: Global HTTP/SOCKS proxy for all downloads; empty = no proxy. Each download can also set its own proxy (in Advanced options).
settings.maxConcurrentHint: Maximum number of simultaneous downloads (0 = unlimited).
settings.dirHint: Files are stored in category sub-folders under this path.
settings.catHint: Files are auto-sorted into matching sub-folders by extension. Order matters — first match wins.

empty.hint: Paste a link or click below — IDIN does the rest
